endorsements.quote: Third, equity metrics should include measurement of LLM usage across protected identity classes (i.e., gender, language) and examine whether adoption is linked to differences in downstream outcomes for patients’ health and care team workplace burden.
Ensure diverse representation in training data and in teams that develop AI tools

unlisted_practices: Health care organization leadership should demand that LLM developers incorporate diverse patient voices in design, evaluation, and implementation.
Evaluate LLM-based tools continuously throughout the tool's life cycle, with special attention to vendor-purchased tools whose performance metrics are opaque.
Create industry standards and standardized assessments for equity-related LLM performance metrics across patient groups and settings.
Be transparent with patients about the abilities and usage of LLMs to enhance patient trust.

screen.reason: This is a commentary summarizing regulations and guidelines regarding health equity, oversight, and safe deployment of large language models in healthcare.
